chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Ibn Ri'ab, from Abu Ubayda al-Hazza', from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)

Regarding the Statement of Allah, Mighty and Majestic: 'Cursed were those who disbelieved from among the Children of Israel on the tongue of Dawud and Isa, son of Maryam.' He said: 'The pigs [were cursed] on the tongue of Dawud, and the monkeys [were cursed] on the tongue of Isa, son of Maryam (peace be upon them).
ai.seo_question: What did the curse on the Children of Israel manifest as according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi offers a specific exegetical interpretation of Surah Al-Imran 5:78, distinguishing the forms of divine punishment by attributing the transformation into pigs to the curse of Prophet Dawud and monkeys to that of Isa. It highlights the Shia scholarly tradition of linking specific historical curses to their respective prophetic sources, thereby clarifying the distinct nature of the degradation mentioned in the Quranic text.
